title: Looking for 3 systematic crypto traders to improve a strategy validation workflow with me
author: Rare_Inflation3178
selftext:
I’m working on a hands-on validation workflow for people who already research or run systematic crypto strategies.

I’m looking for three traders willing to bring one existing hypothesis, backtest, or paper/live discrepancy and work through it with me.

The goal is to strengthen the evidence behind the strategy: checking data assumptions, leakage, trading costs, walk-forward/OOS stability, kill criteria, and what would need to be true before trusting the result.

This is an early AlphaGate design-partner test. The product is still early and pricing is not finalized. The work runs in a sandbox, and your inputs are not added to AlphaGate’s database. There are no performance or profit promises, and you don’t need to reveal your core formula publicly.

I’m specifically looking for people who already build or run systematic crypto strategies and can complete one full workflow this week. If that sounds relevant, comment with whether you’re currently in backtest, paper, or small-live stage, and which part of validation takes the most time.
